title: InfiniBand Global Route Header (GRH)
summary: The InfiniBand GRH (Global Route Header) is a 40-byte header for routed packets (between subnets). Fields: IP version (4 bits), traffic class (8), flow label (20), payload length (16), next header (8), hop limit (8), source GID (16 bytes), destination GID (16 bytes).

ext.summary: The InfiniBand GRH (Global Route Header) is a 40-byte header for routed packets (between subnets). Fields: IP version (4 bits), traffic class (8), flow label (20), payload length (16), next header (8), hop limit (8), source GID (16 bytes), destination GID (16 bytes).

structure.meaning: Length of the payload (including the InfiniBand headers).

ext.example_decoded: InfiniBand GRH: version 6, next header 0x1B (BTH), hop limit 64
notes: InfiniBand uses GIDs (Global Identifiers) for routing between subnets.
GID = subnet prefix (64 bits) + GUID (64 bits).
InfiniBand is used in HPC, AI training clusters, and high-performance storage.
RoCE (RDMA over Converged Ethernet) uses the same GRH over Ethernet.
